messages:
Tara Gomez: quick pass on the alerting rule detail pane in staging — two things stood out on a 13" viewport: channel list pushes the preview off-screen when there are 5+ channels, and the suppression label text is inconsistent (we show 'Snooze' in the rule list but 'Quiet window' in previews). gif: https://.../rule-pane-scroll.gif :grimacing:
Noah Li: agree on both. For channel overflow, what about collapsing into a small cluster pill that expands on click/hover and still exposes keyboard focus? e.g. "+3 more" pill that opens a popup list. Keeps primary actions visible.
Omar Haddad: accessibility: the popup needs role="menu" and proper roving tabindex. Also when the popup opens we should announce only once: "Channel list expanded. 3 more channels available." Right now VO reads each item twice because we set aria-live in two places.
Riley Knox: copy nit: switch all instances to use "Quiet window" in the UI and add helper copy "Temporarily silence notifications for this rule". "Snooze" is ambiguous for some customers.
Tara Gomez: spacing idea: instead of increasing vertical padding across the board, tighten chrome (borders/shadows) and introduce a denser compact row variant for rules list. That keeps preview visible while letting detail pane breathe.
Noah Li: keyboard flow: when you tab into the collapsed "+N" pill it currently traps focus in a weird order. expected: Tab to pill, Enter opens popup, arrow keys move between channels, Esc closes and returns focus to pill. We should add a live message on move: "Email moved to position 2" for reorders.
Omar Haddad: proposed small aria fix snippet:
```
// announce once on popup open
const ann = document.getElementById('sr-ann');
ann.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
ann.textContent = `Channel list expanded. ${moreCount} more.`;
setTimeout(() => ann.textContent = '', 1200);
```
Avoids duplicate announces when list re-renders.
Riley Knox: visual contrast: expand the channel pill to filled background for color badges (instead of just a 2px circle). test against WCAG AA for 14px label. preview-bot currently flags some fails.
preview-bot: preview snapshot for thread 1815556666 — result: WARN (2 contrast fails, 1 focus-order warn)
Tara Gomez: can someone own the contrast + keyboard flow tickets? I'll iterate on copy and compact row mock in Figma.
Noah Li: I'll take keyboard/roving-tab ticket: DESIGN-1210 — channel cluster keyboard + live announcements. cc @Omar @Riley :white_check_mark:
Omar Haddad: I'll file DESIGN-1211 for contrast fixes and update the component token for filled pills.
Riley Knox: I'll change wording to "Quiet window (ends)" and add helper "Use named schedules for repeated windows (e.g., Weekend quiet)." We'll test in next usability round.
Tara Gomez: awesome. Moving this to design-review board. thanks all! :sparkles:
